results.title: Weeknight laksa searches climb during exam season
results.snippet: Singapore search interest in 'easy laksa' and '15 minute laksa' rises sharply through exam and year-end work weeks. Home cooks want hawker flavour without a two-hour stock.

results.title: Hostel and dorm cooking: air fryer hawker hacks
results.snippet: University and hostel cooks in Singapore are adapting hawker staples like otah and satay to air fryers because wok access is limited. Short-form demand outstrips supply.

results.title: Laksa Lab: local paste brand, strong product, thin social
results.snippet: Laksa Lab sells a rempah paste from a small Singapore shopfront with steady retail pickup, but posts almost no short-form video. Competitors with weaker product out-reach them online.

results.title: Katong laksa: what locals actually order
results.snippet: Tourist-facing laksa content dominates search while locals complain the ordering script is never shown. Stall owners are open to collaborations that show the correct order.

results.title: Dessert how-tos underperform savoury in SG food short-form
results.snippet: Chendol and ice kacang tutorials show lower completion and save rates than noodle content among Singapore home-cook audiences over the last two quarters.

results.title: Singapore home cooks want stall-accurate recipes, not fusion
results.snippet: Audience research on 20-30 year old Singapore home cooks shows strong preference for recipes that name the originating stall and avoid fusion reinterpretation.
